description: Deterministic expectations for the 16 registered PARS MCP tools. JSON cases are single calls checked against direct read-only SQL oracles on the isolated synthetic database (proj_001, proj_002) or the isolated synthetic mock copy (source). Scripted scenarios for write-capable, training, prediction, signing, and fixture cases live in eval/phoenix/run_pars_gap_eval.py. No LLM judge is used; every check is deterministic.

cases.objective: Project inventory matches the projects and wbs_elements tables.

checks.sql: SELECT parsid, project_name FROM projects
SELECT parsid, count(*), max(level) FROM wbs_elements GROUP BY parsid

cases.objective: Exact project metadata for proj_001.

checks.sql: SELECT p.parsid, p.project_name, count(e.wbs_code), max(e.level) FROM projects p JOIN wbs_elements e ON e.parsid = p.parsid WHERE p.parsid = 'proj_001' GROUP BY p.parsid, p.project_name

cases.objective: Case-insensitive project ID resolves to the stored proj_001 metadata.

checks.sql: SELECT p.parsid, p.project_name, count(e.wbs_code), max(e.level) FROM projects p JOIN wbs_elements e ON e.parsid = p.parsid WHERE p.parsid = 'proj_001' GROUP BY p.parsid, p.project_name

cases.objective: Unknown project is refused, not answered with an empty record.
Blank project ID is refused.
Full element list for proj_001 equals the wbs_elements rows.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001'
SELECT wbs_code, title, level, parent_wbs, leaf_node FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001'

cases.objective: SQL LIKE pattern filter returns exactly the matching codes.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND wbs_code LIKE '01.01.01.%'

cases.objective: Level window filter is inclusive on both ends.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND level BETWEEN 3 AND 4

cases.objective: min_level outside 1 to 8 is refused.
max_level outside 1 to 8 is refused.
Unknown project is refused.
Whitespace-only project ID is refused (it would otherwise match every project).
Element and its immediate children match wbs_elements (parent_wbs link).

checks.sql: SELECT wbs_code, title, level, parent_wbs, leaf_node FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND wbs_code = '01.01'
SELECT wbs_code FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND parent_wbs = '01.01'

cases.objective: A leaf has no children.

checks.sql: SELECT wbs_code FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND parent_wbs = '01.01.01.01.01.01.01'

cases.objective: Unknown WBS code must not return a fabricated element.
Lineage runs from the element to the root through every dot-prefix ancestor.
A root element's lineage is itself.
Unknown code yields no fabricated ancestors (empty list or an error).
Leaf set equals rows with leaf_node true (11 for proj_001).

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND leaf_node
SELECT wbs_code, title, level FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND leaf_node

cases.objective: Leaf set equals rows with leaf_node true for proj_002.

checks.sql: SELECT wbs_code, title, level FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_002' AND leaf_node

cases.objective: Unknown project is refused.
Level 1 contains only the root element.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND level = 1
SELECT wbs_code, title, parent_wbs, leaf_node FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND level = 1

cases.objective: Level 7 count equals the SQL count (deepest level).

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM wbs_elements WHERE parsid = 'proj_001' AND level = 7

cases.objective: Level 0 is refused.
Level 9 is refused.
Blank project ID is refused before the level is used.
Mock source passes the contract, reports synthetic_mock, and row counts match the source copy.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM silver_spae_data

cases.objective: Default limit 20 returns 20 rows with the documented columns; total equals the source row count.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM silver_spae_data

cases.objective: Limit is honoured exactly.
Limit 0 is refused.
Limit above 500 is refused.
Default limit returns 20 description rows; total equals the source table.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM silver_project_descriptions

cases.objective: Limit 0 is refused.
Unknown run is refused.
A path-like run ID is refused by the format check before any file access.
